card.name: Punctuation opening numbered lists
card.fires_on: The period after a list number (1. 5. 3.) or the colon that introduces a list, most often in a contraindications section. Also seen on a decimal point or a digit inside a number.

modes.label: List number period
modes.description: The period right after a digit that starts a numbered item.
modes.example: CONTRAINDICATIONS Danazol capsules should not be administered to patients with: 1<<.>> Undiagnosed abnormal genital bleeding.

modes.label: Colon before a list
modes.description: A colon after 'contraindicated in patients with' or 'for' that introduces the items.
modes.example: 4 CONTRAINDICATIONS XTAMPZA ER is contraindicated in patients with<<:>> Significant respiratory depression [see Warnings and

modes.label: Inside numbers
modes.description: A decimal point or digit within a numeric value or trial ID.
